name: COVID Conquest
author: Phoenix_Firebird
description:
This is my first game, more or less. Some code is copied from the Brackeys YouTube channel, and the idea was taken from another YouTube video, though I changed and modified it to make it my own. Nevertheless, I started this game from a blank Unity project.                                                             
To play, use WASD to move. Background music is audible if you enable sound.                                                                                                                
Any constructive feedback is welcome!
